Are you interested in working alongside our 2,300 employees to ensure the health of our population? To strengthen this team in the gynecological practice at the Schüpfen location, we are looking for one as of August 1st, 2026 or by appointment: Medical practice assistant, 60% This is what you do Together with a dedicated team of MPA, midwives and gynecologists, you look after the patients of the gynecological clinic at the Schüpfen location Typically tasks: Telephone contact, reception and making appointments, preparing patients for consultations with weight and blood pressure reduction, Blood samples, etc. Administrative work such as registering reports, patient management also via email (KISIM, Synedra) can be done with friends and efficiency. Structured work is a given for you. You are familiar with the area of responsibility of a dynamic practice. Patient contact and the professional execution of treatment-related nursing activities are your top priority. Strong IT application knowledge (e.g. MS Office, KISIM, etc.) High social skills and personal responsibility as well as patient orientation. We look forward to receiving your complete online application.
